Name: eihwaz's farmer portraits
Author: eihwaz1111
Description:
These were originally painted for myself, but anyone can apply them to their farmer.

You need [CP] Farmer Emotion along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url] when you want to make your farmer react to NPCs' emotion.

(The farmer's hair is based on one of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2869]Coii's[/url].)
